explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/1100: g(k) = max τ_⊥(n) over squarefree n with ω(n) = k; 'Determine the growth of g(k)'. In Lean g k is the supremum of tauPerp n over squarefree n with ω n = k (bounded by 2^k), matching the definition, and the value question reads 'determine the growth' as g =Θ[atTop] answer. The definition is faithful. As with other open-ended 'growth' questions, the statement admits the trivial answer g itself and fixes Θ-precision as the target, whereas the docstring itself notes that even the base of the exponential is unknown ((√2 + o(1))^k < g(k) < (2−c)^k); a formulation in terms of lim g(k)^{1/k} would arguably be closer to what is being asked.
